create.title: Bring your team into Leo
create.intro: A shared workspace for the work you do together. Personal stays yours: mail, calendar, notes and boards are private until you choose to share something.

meetings.title: Shared meetings
meetings.text: Share a recording from your Notes, or let notes go to the right people when a meeting ends. Meetings with guests stay private.

work.title: Projects, tasks and decisions
work.text: What was decided and who owes what, grouped by project. Your tasks also show up in your own Productivity and Kanban.

knowledge.title: Team knowledge
knowledge.text: Share files from your File Manager, upload new ones, or connect a shared drive. Leo answers from them for whoever may see them.
